name: YOOPAI PETG @Qidi X-Plus 4 0.4 nozzle
filament_notes:
YOOPAI manufacturer data, generated by scripts/shop_profiles/gen_filaments.py.
Manufacturer max speed 300 mm/s.
Max volumetric speed raised to 18 mm3/s (printer profile 12) from the manufacturer's 300 mm/s rating, capped at 18 for this printer.
COPIED FROM CREALITY: the yoopai.com and Amazon text for this PETG is Creality's CR-PETG listing text nearly word for word, with 'Creality' changed to 'Our' (same typo 'enbale', same 'especially suitable for Creality 3D Printers!', same 220-250C nozzle / 70-80C bed). On Amazon it shares a variation family with the 'Official CREALITY PETG' listings that YOOPAI resells, and a newer relisting is titled 'YOOPAI Official PETG ... Better Flow, Moistureproof 3D Printing CR PETG Filament' (B0H45PG846), echoing Creality's title. Recorded values are YOOPAI's published text (yoopai.com black/transparent pages): nozzle 220-250C, bed 70-80C. The 'Printing Setting' image on the same yoopai.com pages says nozzle 230-250C, bed 60-80C, print speed <300 mm/s (max speed taken from that image; Creality's CR-PETG spool label also says 230-250C). Images also say 'Drying for 4-6 hours before printing is recommended' (no temperature; drying_hours = upper bound 6) and HDT 70C at 0.45 MPa. 1.75 +/-0.03 mm. Colours include Black, Transparent, Grey, Red, Yellow, and 'A-...-new' transparent colours.
Source: https://www.yoopai.com/products/petg-filament-3d-printer-filament-1-75mm-1kg-2-2lbs-black
